## Learning Objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Integrate multiple Ibis concepts in complete analytical workflows
- Build end-to-end data pipelines for business intelligence
- Apply best practices for production data analysis
- Solve complex analytical problems using combined techniques

This chapter presents a complete, practical example of using Ibis for market analysis
using the World of Warcraft auction house data.
